subject: اللغة العربية
provenance: Seven user-supplied 2026–2027 official Bahrain Ministry of Education plan PDFs, inspected with text extraction and rendered source tables on 2026-10-25. Their bytes are NOT present in this Git repository.
warning: Index contains scheduled reading titles only. Some grades group several readings in a week; row lessonNumber is an INDEX ORDINAL, not always the Ministry lesson number. No teaching content or source textbook pages are inferred. Publishing, licensed textbook reproduction and equivalence need independent review.
scope: 38 reading topics and 16 listening topics from Bahrain Plan1 (grades 2–4) S1; other grades/components pending index review

sourceDocumentReviewFlags.impact: Do not automatically assign this file's lessons to either stream or claim ministry-approved equivalence before obtaining a corrected/confirmed source.
sourceDocumentReviewFlags.action: Confirm with Ministry or official 2026–2027 stream distribution. Retain file as unverified for automated mapping.
